name: Best Nightcrawler Comics Reading List
description: Kurt Wagner teleports into the X-Men in 1975 and these picks follow him from Claremont's X-Men to leading Excalibur, his solo series, Amazing X-Men and a stint as Uncanny Spider-Man. Four standalone favorites close the list. 4 comics from the source order aren't in the app's comic data yet, so they don't appear among this order's issues.
sourceOrigin: Selected by Proxy616 on r/marvelcomics; expanded into original issues for this project
